patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: It burns every time I pee and I feel like I have to go constantly. No fever, no back pain — I've had this before, it's a bladder infection.
clinical.presentationShort: 25yo F — dysuria, frequency, urgency, NO flank pain or fever, suprapubic tenderness — uncomplicated cystitis.
clinical.presentationLong: 25-year-old female with dysuria, urinary frequency, and urgency, without flank pain or fever, with mild suprapubic tenderness — uncomplicated cystitis.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → urinalysis, short antibiotic course; discharge. (Fever/flank pain would make it pyelonephritis.)
diagnosis.why: Dysuria + frequency, NO fever/flank pain = simple cystitis. Treat and street. Flank pain + fever = pyelo (higher).

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 25-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting comfortably, arms in her lap. Expression: mildly annoyed but otherwise well. Clearly visible: a healthy, well-looking young woman with no signs of distress. No text, no logos.
